environment.note: Moi truong Colab CPU, khong phai may local that su co 2 vCPU co dinh nhu de cuong de xuat - can luu y khi so sanh.

tokenization_config.padding: max_length (co dinh, khong dung dynamic padding)

notes: Latency gan nhu khong phu thuoc do dai code thuc te (tuong quan ~-0.18) vi dung padding='max_length' co dinh 512 token - chi phi tinh toan gan nhu hang dinh cho moi mau.
Do bien dong khong nho (std~357ms, max~3642ms) co the do Colab la moi truong dung chung tai nguyen, khong phai may chuyen dung - can luu y khi bao cao ket qua tuyet doi.
Neu trien khai thuc te tren CI/CD voi so luong file lon, nen can nhac dynamic padding hoac batch inference de giam thoi gian tong the.
